main.name: Sara
main.title: AI & Data Engineer
main.tagline: Always learning, mostly about data, AI and the systems in between.
bio: I'm an AI and data engineer. I spent three years inside a bank, where data has to be right and systems can't go down. In my last year there I led two agents into production: one migrates contractual document templates off a legacy stack, the other answers configuration tickets. My favourite work is shaping data for machine learning.

Now I work remotely, building AI workflows on AWS Bedrock for a US client, and I finally have time to build my own things in the open. I believe AI should make people's lives better. Open source and Linux are where I feel at home.
